seoTitle: VO2 Max Estimator (Cooper 12-Minute Test or Heart Rate Ratio)
metaDescription: Estimate VO2 max in ml/kg/min from the distance covered in a 12-minute run (Cooper) or from maximum and resting heart rate (Uth).
intro: Estimate VO2 max from a Cooper run or from heart rates.
why:
Pick a method. The Cooper test uses the distance you cover in 12 minutes of hard running on flat ground: VO2 max = (metres - 504.9) / 44.73. The heart rate method uses 15.3 x max heart rate / resting heart rate (Uth et al.).

Both are field estimates. The heart rate version was fitted on well-trained men, and it is weaker when max heart rate is a guess. The page does not rank the result by age and sex, because the norm tables could not be checked against a source.
howTo: Choose Cooper or the heart rate method.
Enter the distance or the two heart rates.
Retest under the same conditions to track change.

faq.q: Why no age and sex ranking?
faq.a: Published norm tables differ and could not be verified here, so the tool leaves them out rather than guess.
